==More information needed==
Dreadlords during the [[War of Power]] (as referenced in the first line of [[Forsaken]]) needs to be covered here.
At [[War of Power]], this may be problematic:
{{quote|However, many Aes Sedai - including some of the most powerful - went over to the Shadow and become the Dark One's Chosen - called the Forsaken by the forces of the Light - as leaders and generals on the opposite side of the battle.}}
Did all Aes Sedai who went to the shadow become "Chosen"? Or were some of them just "Dreadlords"? If not, where did these "Dreadlords" come from? --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 20:56, 9 October 2006 (UTC)

:I don't think so. I think that most Aes Sedai just became Dreadlords, and the ones who where allowed to channel the True Power became Chosen. Or something like that. I don't know if something is stated in the books. [[User:Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin|Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin]] 20:18, June 3, 2011 (UTC)

::The term "Dreadlord" didn't show up until the Trolloc Wars, so there weren't any in the Age of Legends. In the AoL, all of the Aes Sedai (men and women) who turned to the Dark One were called Chosen/Forsaken. Over the next three thousand years, those titles came to describe the thirteen that were sealed in the Bore. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 21:38, June 3, 2011 (UTC)
